== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[3,720 To 1 (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_23</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 23), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-23-3_720_To_1.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-3720to1-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[3,720 To 1 (V)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “Deploy on table. Droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, may place the bottom 2 cards in Lost Pile out of play to deploy (from Lost Pile) Forced Servitude, a character weapon, a location, or an Effect that deploys on a location (without 'lose' in game text). (Immune to Alter.)(Original concept by Garrett Larson - North Dakota States 2005)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_23</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-23-3_720_To_1-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
